result: Separate review and confirmation create or reuse exact X and DeviantArt drafts from one confirmed owned preview. Later literal replacement edits preserve before/after revisions and clear approval. Source originals and durable Conversation context remain intact.
persistence: Existing PostDistributionPlan/Variant rows and row builders. conversation_draft_v1 in server-owned assistantPlan JSON holds pinned source/export and per-destination revisions. Unique conversationalGroupKey scopes the plan; no schema/migration. History is application-enforced append-only, not database-enforced immutable.

api.read: GET /session/:sessionId/drafts; unique current drafts, per-variant revision history and confirmation receipts, independent of current catalog revision
api.copy: X {postText}; DeviantArt {title, bodyText, tags}. Explicit literal text, bounded destination input, no model call or formatter truncation.

safeguards: Existing authenticated creator/account/session and mutation gates
Server-owned unique selection and confirmed preview receipt
Owned active source version and retained ready preview provenance
Pending source presentation digest, exact copy and revision checked at confirmation
Serializable transaction, identity lock, variant/session compare-and-set and receipt replay
Legacy patch/approve/handoff rejected for managed variants
Legacy active-plan/Coach lookup excludes only conversation-draft namespace
Rail copy seed blocks managed targets, including null-plan fallback, before source mutations
Refresh preserves confirmed draft and preview receipts

checked: imported Patreon source X/DA exact drafts
independent destinations and concurrent destination reuse
replacement edit history and approval reset
stale revision, overlong copy, wrong preview and changed-source rejection

limits: Synthetic local records and injected authentication only; no actual account or cloud writes.
No paid model calls, product UI mount, frontend/extension tests or builds, browser check, installed-extension execution, API restart, production migration or deployment. Publishing remains manual.
Historical unrelated distribution-package fixture failures and generic PostgreSQL concurrency error-code failure remain recorded; full backend suite is not claimed green.
PCB05/06 are authorized successors; neither was implemented before this acceptance.
